# orionbelt_access_review (Data Source)

Effective access across machines, checked live against the provider's compliance frameworks. Unlike plan-time checks this also sees grants made outside Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orionbelt_access_review" "all" {}

check "access_review" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.orionbelt_access_review.all.compliant
    error_message = "Access review has findings: ${jsonencode(data.orionbelt_access_review.all.findings)}"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `machine_ids` (List of String) Machines to review. Default: every machine.

### Read-Only

- `compliant` (Boolean) True when there are no findings.
- `entries` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `findings` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--findings))
- `frameworks` (List of String)
- `generated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `access_type` (String) ssh, scp, rdp, vnc, k8s, or "*" from a role.
- `expires_at` (String)
- `machine_id` (String)
- `machine_name` (String)
- `remote_users` (List of String)
- `source` (String) "role:<role>" or "permission:<grant id>".
- `user_id` (String)
- `username` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--findings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `findings`

Read-Only:

- `controls` (String)
- `machine_name` (String)
- `message` (String)
- `rule` (String)
- `username` (String)
